_meta.what: Russian brands for the typosquat rule (api/services/scoring.py _check_typosquatting_v2), loaded by api/services/ru_brands.py. Format and fields: that module's docstring. Every domain below was checked on 2026-09-27: its name servers against the brand's own, where http:// lands, the page title, and the registry's whois or Wikidata (P856, official website) where DNS alone was not proof.
_meta.selection: A brand is here when a 2025-26 fraud report names it, or names its category (banks, government services, telecom operators, delivery services) and it is among that category's largest in Russia. Names are the brand's Latin spelling, its short form where people use one (sber, tbank), and the Cyrillic name when that name is not an ordinary word.

sources.cbr_2025: Bank of Russia, 'Обзор операций, совершенных без добровольного согласия клиентов финансовых организаций', 2025 (cbr.ru/analytics/ib/operations_survey/2025/): 37,416 resources restricted on the Bank's information; 43% were phishing sites copying the names of well-known banks and investment companies; the largest thefts combined social engineering with phishing copies of commercial organisations', federal bodies' and government services' sites.
sources.f6_h1_2025: F6, 'Бренды под ударом' (f6.ru, 2025-09-02): retail 50% of phishing, banks and finance 32%; about 80% of fraudulent resources exploit well-known brands.
sources.f6_h1_2026: F6, 'Бренды под прицелом' (vedomosti.ru press release, 2026-09-16): retail 69% of phishing; the .ru share of phishing domains fell to 5%, with .shop 22%, .com 19%, .pro 10% — the brand's name under another TLD is the live shape.
sources.cicada8_q1_2026: CICADA8 via ru-bezh.ru (2026-05-25): phishing most often imitated Т-Банк, ВТБ, Альфа-Банк, Уралсиб, Озон Банк, Банк России, Ozon, Wildberries, Avito, СДЭК, Яндекс Маркет, RuStore, MAX, Telegram, ВКонтакте.
sources.solar_cicada8_2026: Rossiyskaya Gazeta (2026-09-25) citing Solar AURA (H1 2026) and CICADA8 (Q2 2026): copies of banks' log-in pages, «Госуслуги», VK ID, «Одноклассники», MAX, Telegram and telecom operators.
sources.sber_2024: Sber: about 19,000 phishing sites imitating the Sber brand blocked in 2024 (Sberbank Threat Intelligence, via new-retail.ru).
sources.f6_mamont: F6 (then Group-IB), 'Охота на «Мамонта»' (Habr, 2021-03-22): fake courier-service pages, with cdek.nu, cdek.in, cdek.at, cdek-box.ru and cdek-dostavka.info as examples; F6 via CNews (2026-08-10): Яндекс Доставка fakes spelled with typos, and about 50 brands used by the scheme, almost all Russian.
sources.post_2026: dp.ru (2026-02-14): messages about a parcel or letter from «Почта России» with a link to a third-party site; 56.ru (2026-08-22): copies of known delivery services' sites with track-number bots.

left_out.max (MAX messenger), mir (Мир, nspk.ru),: three-letter words: max.com is HBO Max's, mos.org the Museum of Science's, mir.az someone else's; 20, 9 and 6 more of the Tranco top-1M names are exact or one-letter matches.
left_out.cbr (Банк России): named by CICADA8, but 'cbr' is an acronym other organisations own (cbr.com, cbr.nl, cbr.de in the top-1M); with TLD confusion off only look-alikes of three letters would be left.
left_out.nalog (ФНС): the Russian word for 'tax', and its one-letter neighbours are ordinary names (analog, nolog, nanog, nxlog): 15 hits in the Tranco 100k-1M range. No report names it.
left_out.pochta: the Russian word for 'mail': poczta.pl (Polish webmail), pochta.uz, pochta.tech and thepochta.ru are other owners'. Russian Post is here as 'russianpost' and 'почтароссии'.
left_out.raiffeisen: not named in the reports, and the name is a European banking group's: raiffeisen.at, .ch, .ua and hundreds of local Raiffeisen banks.
left_out.gazprom: F6 counts fuel-and-energy brands (22% of scam resources in H1 2026) without naming one; Gazprom's own warnings are about calls and letters, and its legitimate family is large (gazprom-neft, gazprom-media, azsgazprom …). Gazprombank is here.
left_out.yoomoney, kaspersky, boxberry, kinopoisk: no 2025-26 report found that names them.
left_out.ok (Одноклассники): two letters; the brand is here as 'odnoklassniki', and 'одноклассники' is the ordinary word for 'classmates'.
left_out.t2, vk (as typo targets): names under three letters are never compared (#61); 'vk' is kept for combos such as vk-login, 'tele2' for T2.
